ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black/dark-grey field with high-intensity white/grey pixel clusters and lines; approximate 90:10 ratio of dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark field across both lobes; high-contrast white clusters localized at distal tips; sparse linear white streaks distributed across the central and lateral lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp convergence point; depth occupies approximately 15 percent of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; distinct pixel-amplitude peaks located on the upper margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips on the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white clusters on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller white circular spots visible near the ventral peduncle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear rake marks; three primary diagonal streaks on the left lobe and several shorter horizontal/oblique marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue scarring and high-contrast pigmentation at both distal fluke tips; distinct white vertical mark at the central base near the water interface.
